objective: Operational readiness verification for ARCHAIOS production deployment.

checks.title: Git worktree is not release-clean
checks.action: Classify, commit, archive, or explicitly discard all dirty worktree entries before production deployment.

checks.title: Duplicate Worker implementations exist
checks.action: Choose one canonical Worker implementation and retire or archive the non-canonical path.

checks.title: Project Sentinel has actionable findings
checks.action: Resolve Project Sentinel findings before production.

checks.title: Client dependency audit passes
checks.evidence: npm audit found no moderate-or-higher client vulnerabilities.

checks.title: Live GitHub repository is reachable
checks.evidence: saintblack-ai/archaios-system; default branch main. Latest runs reachable: yes.

checks.title: Cloudflare Worker identity mismatch
checks.evidence: HTTP 200; expected service archaios-saas-worker, got archaios-daily-automation.
checks.action: Deploy the canonical revenue Worker with `npx wrangler deploy --name archaios-saas-worker` and verify /api/health identity.

checks.title: Supabase auth health failed
checks.action: Verify Supabase project status and configured project URL.

checks.title: Stripe metrics are not connected
checks.evidence: STRIPE_SECRET_KEY is not available to Iron Gate.
checks.action: Run Iron Gate from an approved environment with read-only Stripe access or verify metrics through a controlled backend endpoint.
